    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Oracle 26ai 应用 RU 补丁简明版</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-11-10 07:39">2026-11-10 07:39</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">42</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(23610421);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F23610421&amp;targetId=23610421&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>定期更新 Oracle 26ai 的 RU 是日常运维的一部分。笔者把这次从 23.26.2 升级到 23.26.4 的操作步骤记录下来，供有类似需求的读者参考。</p>
<h2 id="01--找到并下载补丁">01 | 找到并下载补丁</h2>
<p>通过文档 888.1 可以快速定位需要的 RU：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>This was MOS Document ID: 888.1 in Legacy MOS.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202611/635610-20261110073918607-339489308.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>笔者选择了当时最新的 10 月发布的 RU：</p>
<p><code>Patch 40007731: DATABASE RELEASE UPDATE 23.26.4.0.0</code></p>
<p>打补丁用的 OPatch 工具通常也要匹配版本，因此同时下载最新的 OPatch，同样是 10 月发布：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/635610/202611/635610-20261110073920769-579233046.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="02--升级-opatch">02 | 升级 OPatch</h2>
<p>先查看当前版本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[oracle@alfred-db 23.26.4]$ $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch version
OPatch Version: 12.2.0.1.51

OPatch succeeded.
</code></pre>
<p>替换前请确认处于维护窗口、无其他会话正在使用 OPatch，并已对 ORACLE_HOME 做备份；若新版本异常，可将 OPatch 目录删除后用 OPatch_bak 恢复。备份旧目录并解压新版本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mv $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch_bak
[oracle@alfred-db 23.26.4]$ unzip p6880880_230000_Linux-x86-64.zip -d $ORACLE_HOME/

[oracle@alfred-db 23.26.4]$ $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch version
OPatch Version: 12.2.0.1.55

OPatch succeeded.
</code></pre>
<h2 id="03--应用-ru-补丁">03 | 应用 RU 补丁</h2>
<p>按 readme 文件操作，核心步骤如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">unzip p40007731_230000_Linux-x86-64.zip
cd 40007731
$ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckMinimumOPatchVersion -ph ./
$ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir /u01/media/23.26.4/40007731
</code></pre>
<p>在维护窗口内、确认业务已通知且数据库有可用备份后再执行；若 shutdown immediate 长时间未完成，先排查活动会话再决定是否强制关闭。关闭监听和数据库：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">lsnrctl stop
sqlplus / as sysdba
SQL&gt; shutdown immediate
</code></pre>
<p>应用补丁：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">$ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch apply
</code></pre>
<p>关键成功标志如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">---
Patch 40007731 successfully applied.
Sub-set patch [39093711] has become inactive due to the application of a super-set patch [40007731].
Please refer to Doc ID 2161861.1 for any possible further required actions.

***** There are 2 inactive RU patches in chain 1

***** 1 inactive patches will be deleted
Log file location: /opt/oracle/product/26ai/dbhome_1/cfgtoollogs/opatch/opatch2026-11-09_17-02-47PM_1.log

OPatch succeeded.
</code></pre>
<h2 id="04--执行-datapatch">04 | 执行 datapatch</h2>
<p>readme 中说明，补丁打完后还需要启动数据库并执行 datapatch：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">$ sqlplus /nolog
SQL&gt; Connect / as sysdba
SQL&gt; startup

SQL&gt; alter pluggable database all open; 

SQL&gt; quit
$ cd $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch
$ ./datapatch -sanity_checks   # 可选，用于执行前检查
$ ./datapatch -verbose
</code></pre>
<p>执行前可先用 opatch lspatches 确认补丁已应用；datapatch 耗时可能较长，请耐心等待。若出现错误，应先查看 sqlpatch 日志并处理，不要直接启动监听对外提供服务。确认最终成功标识：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">Installing patches...

Patch installation complete.  Total patches installed: 3

Validating logfiles...done
Patch 40007731 apply (pdb CDB$ROOT): SUCCESS
Patch 40007731 apply (pdb PDB$SEED): SUCCESS
Patch 40007731 apply (pdb ORCLPDB1): SUCCESS
SQL Patching tool complete on Mon Nov  9 17:20:06 2026
</code></pre>
<h2 id="05--收尾与验证">05 | 收尾与验证</h2>
<p>对可能存在的无效对象重新编译：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">$ $ORACLE_HOME/perl/bin/perl $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin/catcon.pl -n 1 -e -b utlrp -d $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin utlrp.sql
</code></pre>
<p>此时可以启动监听提供服务。笔者遇到一个小插曲：<code>sqlnet.ora</code> 文件被人修改过，格式有问题（多了一些换行符），导致监听无法启动，修正格式后即正常：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">$ lsnrctl start
</code></pre>
<p>随后通过查询数据库版本、检查组件状态并进行应用连接测试，确认服务正常。</p>
<hr>
